logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Two-panel decision illustration for WO-01. Panel 1: vertical bar chart of measured acceptance-run energy for the four qualified modules (P1 56, P2 12, P3 52, P4 58 kWh), each bar annotated with quality index and raw defect count; P2 marked as policy minimum, P4 marked with a defect-zero flag and dashed callout showing the 6 kWh gap to P3. Panel 2: the six-gate acceptance-run register (suction priming, joint torque check, recirculation flush, quality index check, load hold, zero-drift audit) drawn as an ordered workflow with G4 highlighted. Bottom strip: decision path from register evidence to energy ranking to policy ballot to handover with open questions.
